expert.rationale: Level 3 (rubric anchor: Purpose and audience are clear on the entry surface and the main flow reflects the intended feelings, with minor inconsistencies.) Assessor notes: AI review, offline render, no users observed. The Home gate names the company, the person's role and who works there, then offers Knowledge, Files and Documents as doors. Platforms is a plain register; Points explains how points lapse. Minor: the journey starts on a generic marketing page and sign-in in a different language.

Level 2 (rubric anchor: Some deliberate choices are visible but they are not applied consistently across the main screens.) Assessor notes: AI review, offline render, no users observed. Signed-in Home, Platforms, People and Points carry The Yard. The entry the owner meets first (root, login, register) is a generic SaaS page (white cards over a photo, Baloo 2 and DM Sans) that PRODUCT.md says InfoDot must not resemble. Landing work (R-10) is out of scope and counted as is.

Level 3 (rubric anchor: Main tasks are direct and clear, with minor friction on secondary screens.) Assessor notes: AI review, offline render, no users observed. The gate gives one next step per door. Platforms has one 'Open signed in' action per row, a filter and area index. Minor friction: 25 rows scroll long, and Home overflows by 11px at 375 (the stencil font was missing in this render).

Level 3 (rubric anchor: Spacing, type, states and motion are consistent across screens and breakpoints, with minor roughness.) Assessor notes: AI review, offline render, no users observed. Consistent type, spacing and states across Home, Platforms, People, Analytics, Profile and Points; measured overflow only on Home at 375px (+11px). Reduced-motion coverage is partial.

Level 2 (rubric anchor: Claims and data handling are mostly honest; some states or notices are vague or incomplete.) Assessor notes: AI review, offline render, no users observed. Points states its rules (oldest spent first, what lapses and when, 'Unavailable right now'). But '25 of 25 platforms are live' is a config flag this review could not check against hosts, the policy omits the third-party services loaded on each page, and lapse wording needs the ethics gate to review.

Level 2 (rubric anchor: The main flow is accessible; secondary screens or states have barriers.) Assessor notes: AI review, offline render, no users observed. No assistive-technology test. Controls are mostly named; :focus-visible is on by default. The Points checkbox ring is 1.3:1 on the dark theme, 18 rendered low-contrast hits on the root page, and the first-contact pages use a different markup set that was not reviewed in depth.
